questions.prompt: Order these metals from MOST to LEAST reactive.
questions.explain: K > Mg > Zn > Fe > Cu > Au.

options: a less reactive metal is added to a salt of a more reactive metal
a more reactive metal is added to a salt solution of a less reactive metal
a metal is heated in air
questions.explain: The more reactive metal displaces the less reactive one.
Only a metal higher in the series displaces one lower down. Copper is above silver, so it displaces silver!
Iron takes copper's place: iron sulfate + copper.

questions.prompt: An iron nail is left in copper sulfate solution. The solution changes from…
questions.explain: Blue copper sulfate becomes pale green iron sulfate.

questions.prompt: Metal X displaces iron from iron sulfate but does NOT displace zinc from zinc sulfate. Where does X fit?
questions.hint: X is more reactive than iron but less reactive than zinc.
questions.explain: More reactive than Fe, less than Zn: between them.

questions.prompt: In the Displacement Duel (Mg, Zn, Fe, Cu, Ag), how many of the four OTHER salt solutions does ZINC react with?
questions.explain: Zinc displaces iron, copper and silver (3), but not magnesium.

questions.prompt: Which metals react with dilute acid to produce hydrogen?
options: Only metals above hydrogen in the reactivity series
questions.explain: Copper, silver and gold (below hydrogen) don't react with dilute acids.

questions.prompt: Match each observation to its explanation.

pairs.left: Brown coating on the iron nail

questions.explain: Every observation in a displacement reaction has a particle explanation.

questions.prompt: Describe how you could use displacement reactions to decide whether tin is more or less reactive than iron.
questions.modelAnswer: Put a piece of tin into iron sulfate solution, and a piece of iron into a tin salt solution. If tin displaces iron (a coating forms), tin is more reactive. If instead iron displaces tin, iron is more reactive. Only one of the two should react.
rubric: Tested tin in an iron salt solution (and/or iron in a tin salt)
Said what a reaction (coating/colour change) would show
Drew a conclusion about which is more reactive
questions.explain: Displacement is a simple, reliable way to rank metals.
